themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents actively participating in or automating aspects of research processes, including data collection, analysis, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing specific AI tools and platforms designed to enhance or automate various research activities.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text, such as articles, reports, or transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design and research
themes.description: Articles exploring how AI is applied to enhance the creative and analytical aspects of user experience and product design research.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the use, impact, and research surrounding AI-powered chatbots, including their applications and limitations.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles related to AI's role in automating or augmenting usability testing processes and analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content discussing the creation and use of AI-generated or simulated user profiles for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and analysis on how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, particularly in relation to research and design roles.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles covering the application of AI to analyze and understand user emotions, opinions, and feedback from various sources.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
